description: The Release 0 exit proof (BUILD-MAP-001 section (d), R0 exit gate): every Release 0 packet (the R0 rows of BUILD-MAP section (c)) with the apps/server suites its records name, the Release 0 manifests that bind each suite, issue #186's seven journey steps (section (b)), and an explanation, with its status, for every skip and todo in those suites. apps/server/src/core/config/release0-proof-coverage.spec.ts checks it; `pnpm --filter server proof:release0` (scripts/proof-admission/release0.mjs) runs scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs over exactly `manifests`, then that spec, then a runtime check of the run's report (a case not run must be explained), and answers MET (0), REJECTED (2) or NOT MET (3: everything proven, OPEN items remain, reported to the owner).
derivation: A packet's suites are, from its own records: (1) the apps/server suites in its BUILD-QUEUE-001.json tests_first; (2) the suites its branch created (git log --diff-filter=A of pkt/<id>, its -repair, the pre-queue branch BUILD-MAP names for it: R0-05 = R0-AB-04, R0-15 = R0-CT-05, R0-17 = R0-PL-03, R0-03 = R0-CT-03, R0-04 = R0-PC-01, R0-11 = R0-PL-07, R0-20 = R0-PL-04; and the R0 follow-ups that landed under it: lettered ids R0-07a, R0-08c, R0-09b..g, R0-13b..g, R0-34b, and the families R0-ID-F* and R0-F24 under R0-05, R0-SEC-01/02 under R0-14, R0-SEC-03/04 under R0-32, R0-CMF1/2 under R0-11, R0-CMF3 under R0-04, R0-CMF4..6 under R0-07, R0-SEC2* under R0-09 (D-11), R0-D1..D7 and R0-QI-01 under R0-16 via release0-landed.json); (3) every suite a manifest with an R0 packageId binds, listed under the packet that packageId names.

A suite an R0 branch only edited (created before the queue or by a V1 packet) is a Release 0 suite too when the R0 packet authored cases in it (R0-35 review SEC-R035-3): it is listed under the R0 row its editor landed under and bound by release0-edited-suites.json (every passing case required). editedOnly keeps the record of who edited and created each such suite; one whose edit authored no case carries authoredNoCase and stays out. A queue tests_first suite that never existed is listed in queueSuitesLandedAs with the suite that carries its proof. A suite holding the proof that closes a Release 0 todo elsewhere is a Release 0 suite under the packet that parked the todo, bound by release0-closing-proofs.json (R0-35 review SEC-R035-2).

The Release 0 manifests are every manifest whose packageId starts with 'R0-' (R0-35 added one per packet whose suites no manifest bound, packageId 'R0-35-EXIT-PROOF:<packet>', every passing case required) plus k12-self.json (R0-16 extends it).

Every explanation has a status (R0-35 review SEC-R035-2, SEC-R035-4): CLOSED (fixed outside the suite; closedBy names a case a Release 0 manifest requires, a line a repo file holds, or a running web unit case), RULED or DEFERRED (an owner ruling of BUILD-MAP section (g)), V1-SCOPE (a V1 packet's residual in a suite an R0 packet only edited; followUp is that queued V1 packet), or OPEN (a Release 0 gap still open; proof:release0 lists it for the owner and answers NOT MET).
